arguments.command: python scripts/verify_acceptance.py 2>&1 | Select-String -Pattern '^(PASS|FAIL|SKIP|RESULT)'; Write-Output '---git status---'; git status --short; Write-Output '---samples diff---'; git diff --exit-code HEAD -- docs data_file examples; Write-Output "samples-diff-rc=$LASTEXITCODE"; Write-Output '---wheel---'; Get-ChildItem dist | Select-Object Name,Length
